simple.summary: יֶשַׁח (yeshach) means hunger First listed occurrence: Mic 6 14.

definitions.full: H3445. yeshach [ יֶ֫שַׁח ] noun [masculine] ? emptiness (of hunger), meaning conjectured from context; Micah 6:14 בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְיֶשְׁהֲךָ (|| תִשְׂבָּ֔ע ולא תאכל ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to gape (as the empty stomach);
